normalized.result: Yes, that's the right response. I pasted the address of something I'd archived, hit **Get details**, and instead of quietly building a brand-new copy it recognized I already had that one tucked away in the Archive — it told me so plainly and showed me its current details. That's important, because otherwise I'd end up with a duplicate and forget the archived original was even there. And I like that it gives me a sensible choice from there: I can update it while leaving it archived, or restore it back into my library. So the "don't make a duplicate, take me to the one I already have" rule holds even when the existing copy is sitting in the Archive. This handles the case well.
